items.title: ii. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with KCN (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: ii. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with KCN: a main subheading of 21.4 Examples of Reactions of Halogenoalkanes, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 82-82.

blocks.text: Cyanide ion (CN⁻) strong (taqatwar) nucleophile hai lekin weak (kamzor) base, is liye yeh halogenoalkanes se substitution product, yani nitrile, deta hai. Aam taur par halogenoalkane ko potassium cyanide ke ethanolic solution (ethanol mein bana solution) ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai. Bromoethane potassium cyanide se react kar ke propanenitrile deta hai; is mein ek carbon zyada ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed bromoethane + K+ -C(triple bond)N, arrow ke oopar 'alcohol', se displayed propanenitrile, H3C-CH2-C(triple bond)N, + KBr.
